description.mn: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mirto Di Panarea: Unisex модлог үнэр (EDT).
description.en: Panarea near Sicily is an an island suspended in time. The smallest and oldest of the Eolie islands, its essence is brought to life in this revitalizing fragrance. A scent characterized by the aromatic notes of myrtle and basil, it opens with lemon and bergamot. At the heart, a sea breeze accord melts with jasmine and rose. Its intense base includes lentisc and juniper with cedarwood and amber. Notes: Myrtle, Basil, Lemon, Bergamot, Sea Breeze Accord, Jasmine, Rose, Lentisc, Juniper, Cedarwood, and Amber. Style: Revitalizing. Intense. Aromatic.
